svg.title: The tsseg demo on a motion-capture recording
svg.desc: A four-channel motion-capture recording (MoCap, trial 0, 4,579 points) as the tsseg demo shows it. Top: the ground truth, seven segments in four states, state A coming back three times. Middle: the change points found by BottomUp with an RBF cost, without being told how many (Covering 0.75), against the true change points. Bottom: the states found by Time2State, told that there are four (State Matching Score 0.93).

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: Sample dataset: MoCap, trial 0 · 4 channels · 4,579 points
